description: The engine-vocabulary vector: the exact sets of names Protocol-Canary's parsers accept, read from the engine's own source at one pinned commit (engineCommit). tools/validate/validate.py's constants and schemas/fixture-v1.schema.json's enums must agree with this file, which tests/test_engine_vocabulary_parity.py checks; the point is that every fixture the validator accepts is one the engine can parse, and every name the engine can parse is one the validator accepts, so drift becomes a failing test instead of a fixture that is accepted by one side and rejected by the other. Each list holds only names the engine's parser accepts at that commit, sorted alphabetically. To update: read the engine source file named next to each list at the new Protocol-Canary commit, rewrite the affected list, set engineCommit to that commit's full 40-character SHA, and change the matching validator constant and schema enum in the same pull request so the parity test stays green. A name that a contract document describes but the parser does not accept does not belong in a list; it belongs in contractOnlyNotImplemented.

engineOnlyNotYetAccepted.note: Names the engine's parser accepts at a later Protocol-Canary commit than engineCommit, which this repository's validator and schema do not accept yet. They are listed here for documentation only and are not compared with the validator: the vector stays pinned at engineCommit until the validator catches up, and moving the pin is a deliberate change that has to update the lists, the validator and the schema together.
